name: Meadowood Napa Valley
positioning: A 250-acre wine-country estate near St. Helena in Napa Valley, with rooms and suites set among the trees, a spa, a three-pool complex, tennis, hiking trails and a Wine Center
best_for: Wine lovers who want a Napa Valley base with its own Wine Center
Spa-goers who want private treatment space and outdoor relaxation lounges
Families and active travelers who want pools, tennis and hiking trails on the estate

facts.text: Meadowood is a 250-acre wine-country estate in Napa Valley.
The estate runs from the ridges of the surrounding mountains through wooded canyons and rows of vineyards to the Napa River's edge.
Napa Valley is about an hour's drive north of San Francisco.
Meadowood has long served as a gathering place for Napa Valley residents and common ground for local vintners and winegrowers.
The accommodations are set amid the trees of the Meadowood estate and furnished for privacy, relaxation and restoration.
Rooms have private porches, with fireplaces, soaking tubs, window seats and sofas.
The Hill House has a terrace with a deep soaking tub and outdoor shower.
The spa's outdoor relaxation lounges have a dry cedar sauna, steam room, plunge pool and outdoor rain shower.
Wooded hillsides frame the five outdoor tennis courts, with pros on call.
The estate's hiking trails give panoramic views of St. Helena and the ridges of Napa Valley.
The Wine Center covers all aspects of wine appreciation and the world's wine regions.
Forum is the central restaurant, serving Napa Valley cuisine indoors and out.

highlights.text: The spa's Tree House Retreat is partly open to the elements, with a fireplace and a hand-hammered copper tub for custom baths.
The three-pool complex has a Fitness Pool for lap swimming, a Family Activities Pool for the youngest guests and a Cabana Pool for adult lounging.
A morning hike on the southern trail often brings views of hot air balloons in the distance over the vineyards.
The Hill House is a one-bedroom retreat on the wooded hillside next to the Meadowood Spa.
One hiking trail ends at a secret meditation labyrinth.

considerations.text: The property is about three miles from the shops and restaurants of downtown St. Helena.
Meadowood has a club, so members from St. Helena and elsewhere in Napa are often at the pool, at lunch or on the tennis courts.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting its luxury positioning.
